Dakka Dakka Dakka: The unit reduces its total penalty to hit rolls in ranged combat by -1, down to a minimum of 0. Blast(x) weapons do not benefit from this rule.

Mob: For every 5 models in your squad with this rule, the unit receives a cumulative bonus of +1 to its Leadership value. As long as a unit contains 20 or more models, it receives the "Fearless" special rule. In addition, any unit reduced to less than half of its starting strength may merge with another unit that has this rule for the remainder of the game. To do so, it must begin the battle round within 2" of the unit it wishes to join. The merge occurs during the Rally phase, before any Leadership tests are taken. From that point on, the two units act as a single unit and receive only one shared order.

Ramshackle: Units with this rule have to roll on the Ramshackle table when they lose their last Hull Point. Vehicles with a transport capacity roll on the Ramshackle table for transports. If the vehicle has been immobilized, the controlling player can roll with any order on the "Ramshackle" table in the next activation and apply the result.

Tellyporta: For each started 1000 points of game size, one unit may be set up for +1 point per Wound according to the rules for Deep strike. Vehicles and Monstrous Creatures may be set up for +4 points per Hull Point / Wound according to the rules for Deep strike. Individual models from a squadron are treated as independent units.

Waaagh!: The army may declare a Waaagh! once per game at the beginning of the Command phase, lasting two battle rounds. Infantry and Walkers with the "Waaagh!" rule gain an additional Movement of 1D6", which is not taken into account when determining which weapons they may fire. Other vehicles, Bikes and Jump pack infantry gain the "Deflect" ability instead if they have moved with their maximum possible movement value (but at least 8"). In a "Skirmish" game the effect only lasts one battle round.
